title: 2017 Software Engineering Exit Exam
source: 2017 Ethiopian University Exit Exam for Software Engineering (MoEE) — Moodle OCR

focusGuide.Fundamentals of Programming: Loops, operators, formulas, variable rules, and basic C/C++/Python syntax.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Stacks, queues, trees, graphs, BFS/DFS, hash tables, and Big-O reasoning.
focusGuide.Java / OOP: Inheritance, interfaces, encapsulation, polymorphism, and Java keywords.
focusGuide.Web Development: HTML/CSS/JS, HTTP methods, AJAX, and client-server roles.
focusGuide.Android: Activity, Intent, Service, Manifest permissions, and APK components.
focusGuide.Database: Keys, normalization, SQL, ER mapping, and ACID properties.
focusGuide.Operating Systems: Process states, deadlock conditions, scheduling, paging, and memory.
focusGuide.Software Engineering: SDLC, requirements, refactoring, code smells, and maintenance.
focusGuide.Project Management: WBS, Gantt, critical path, scope, and planning activities.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Test levels, white/black box, QA goals, and traceability.
focusGuide.Networking: Topologies, OSI/TCP, routing, and protocol behavior.
focusGuide.Security: CIA triad, XSS, firewalls, authentication (PKI/MFA), and risk.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Search algorithms, agents, supervised learning, and heuristics.
focusGuide.C++: User-defined types, pointers, syntax, and valid identifiers.
focusGuide.General: Re-read missed questions and verify definitions in course notes.
